report_topic: Performance Audit on Public Health Infrastructure Facilities and Health Services Management
observations_summary: The audit found significant staff shortages (up to 75%) in the Family Welfare Directorate and high vacancies in AYUSH HCFs, leading to recruitment delays. It also highlighted deficiencies in procurement, quality control, and distribution of medicines, as well as underutilization of funds for various health schemes and a lack of monitoring for SDG-3 targets.
